rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a material template for the child memorandum. Both begin by explaining why a complex, government-wide policy area requires prompt or comprehensive review; establish a specially constituted group of senior officials; name its chairman and members; define a broad study covering policy and organizational questions; contemplate input or assistance from affected agencies and outside interests; and impose a specific reporting deadline. C23 uses similar cabinet-committee machinery and a deadline, but has fewer of the child's detailed study features. C04 is also a study-and-report directive with an interdepartmental body and a full-cooperation instruction, but its structure is less closely parallel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am designating a special task force to review and advise me on employee-management relations in the federal service, composed of the following officials
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am establishing a Cabinet Committee on Water Resources Policy. The committee shall undertake an extensive review of all aspects of water resources policy.
shared_material.explanation: Both create an interdepartmental body to conduct a comprehensive review of a difficult federal policy field and advise the President.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of Labor will serve as Chairman of this task force.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am designating you the Chairman of the Cabinet Committee on Water Resources Policy. The Secretary of Defense and the Secretary of Agriculture will serve with you on the committee as full members
shared_material.explanation: Both proceed from establishing the review body to naming its chair and enumerating senior executive officials as members.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This study will cover the broad range of issues relating to federal employee-management relations, including but not limited to definition of appropriate employee organizations, standards for recognition of such organizations, matters upon which employee organizations may be appropriately consulted
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The committee shall undertake an extensive review of all aspects of water resources policy. Its recommendations for the strengthening, clarification and modernization of water policies, together with a suggested approach to the solution of organizational problems involved
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts the parent's broad substantive-and-organizational review mandate to federal labor-management policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: employees and employee organization representatives, department and agency officials, consultants in labor-management relations, and interested groups and citizens shall be given an opportunity to present their views
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We must do this with a full realization that the States, communities and private citizens are vitally concerned with the policies and actions of the Federal Government.
shared_material.explanation: Both emphasize participation by governmental and nongovernmental interests affected by the policy review.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am asking the task force to report their findings and recommendations to me not later than November 30, 1961.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Its recommendations ... are to be submitted to me not later than December 1, 1954.
shared_material.explanation: The reporting instruction closely shares the formulation of recommendations submitted to the President by a fixed late-year deadline.
